races.paceDynamic: Amicitia is the only confirmed front runner in this large field, meaning she can dictate terms without pressure through comfortable fractions. With one leader and multiple prominent racers like I Bid You Ajou, Mint Man and Alfred Tennyson likely to track behind, the pace will be sustainable rather than cut-throat. The large field of 16 runners combined with yielding ground will create a searching test in the final two furlongs as runners fan out for room. This tactical setup strongly favours hold-up horses and prominent racers with finishing kicks over pure front runners who may face late challenges.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Amicitia gets easy lead and jockey Mulligan judges pace perfectly
scenarios.body: Amicitia sustains her gallop on the yielding ground while late challengers struggle to make up ground in the large field. Her record on straight tracks and ability to dominate from the front pays dividends.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Swamp Leader
scenarios.trigger: If pace becomes searching enough in final quarter-mile to expose front runner
scenarios.body: Little Empire and Apache Outlaw benefit from patient rides as Amicitia's gallop falters in testing conditions. The hold-up brigade get clear runs through the large field to deliver telling strikes.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If I Bid You Ajou or Alfred Tennyson get ideal position tracking Amicitia
scenarios.body: The well-positioned prominent runners can quicken past a weakening leader while avoiding the traffic problems that befall hold-up horses. Their tactical position proves optimal in the large field scramble.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Amicitia goes too slowly and creates sprint finish from 2f out
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with multiple horses converging simultaneously in final furlong. Any horse getting a clear run can capitalise on the moderate early gallop.

races.paceDynamic: God Of Power and Satoyama will ensure genuine early gallop from the front, with both confirmed leaders likely to contest the pace from flag-fall. Tim Toe, Straight Up, Listentodwindblow and Thread Of Gold will track prominently behind the leading pair, creating a decent tempo over this mile trip. The honest pace set by the dual front-runners should set up a proper test of stamina in the final two furlongs. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners who can track the pace and strike late, rather than pure front-runners or hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the dual pace angle creates honest but not suicidal fractions
scenarios.body: The prominent runners can sit perfectly positioned behind God Of Power and Satoyama before striking in the final furlong. Tim Toe or Thread Of Gold benefit most from this tactical setup with their proven ability to settle and finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Closer
scenarios.trigger: If God Of Power and Satoyama go too fast and crack dramatically
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where Sursum Corda's hold-up style suddenly becomes an asset as front-runners fade. Her 7lb weight allowance becomes crucial in a slowly-run finale.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders gets first run and maintains momentum
scenarios.body: Either God Of Power or Satoyama gets the jump on their rival and builds enough lead to hold off late challengers. The winner shows superior class and stamina to sustain the gallop.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Class Differential Decisive
scenarios.trigger: If the handicap marks prove too generous for the top-rated
scenarios.body: Straight Up or Listentodwindblow's superior RPR ratings overcome any tactical disadvantage through pure ability. The Joseph O'Brien stable strikes with superior horseflesh despite unfavourable race shape.

watchPoints.text: God Of Power and Satoyama both missing the break would completely change the race dynamic and favour hold-up horses

Straight Up's positioning early - if tracking closer than usual it suggests tactical change from the O'Brien team
Listentodwindblow's early position given the 64-day gap may reveal fitness levels immediately
Sursum Corda getting prominent early position would indicate jockey abandoning hold-up tactics

races.paceDynamic: Linger For Longer is the lone confirmed front-runner and will set a comfortable tempo without pressure from other natural leaders. The prominent runners James Henry and The Blue Panther will track behind, while the vast majority of this 18-runner field comprises hold-up horses who will need to come from off the pace. With minimal early pace pressure and soft ground that can test stamina reserves, this shape strongly favors front-runners and prominent racers who can secure good positions early and avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will plague the large pack of closers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner
scenarios.trigger: If Linger For Longer gets an easy lead and sustains her gallop
scenarios.body: The mare faces no pace pressure and can dictate fractions before the hold-up brigade gets organized. This tactical advantage on testing ground proves decisive for horses that avoid the scramble.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If James Henry or The Blue Panther improve past the tiring leader
scenarios.body: The prominent pair can stalk the easy pace before moving decisively while the back markers encounter traffic. Their forward positions prove crucial when many closers struggle to find racing room.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes truly pedestrian and hold-up horses get clear runs
scenarios.body: Several hold-up performers find daylight and the soft ground doesn't compromise their finishing kicks. Quality closers like Zabriskie Point and Exceeding demonstrate superior class.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos and Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If traffic problems severely compromise the favorites and an unfancied runner finds a clear path
scenarios.body: The large field creates a scramble that eliminates several fancied runners while a longer-shot holds position. An outsider benefits from the mayhem to steal the prize.

watchPoints.text: Linger For Longer breaking smartly and establishing an uncontested lead could prove decisive given the lack of other pace
Traffic problems developing in the home straight with 18 runners and most needing hold-up tactics
The Blue Panther's fitness after 52 days off following a disappointing Gowran return
James Henry's position tracking the leader as the main threat to the front-runner
Zabriskie Point's headgear change potentially addressing previous finishing problems

races.paceDynamic: Parish Express will take them along from the front with no other confirmed pace-setters in this 14-runner field, creating a sustainable gallop without early pressure. The lack of pace competition means the tempo will be controlled rather than punishing, allowing prominent runners like Ballyadam, Tassarolo, and Baila Conmigo to track comfortably. With most of the field preferring to settle off the pace, including hold-up performers like Sonic Invader, Desert Friend, and Eben Zaabeel, the real action will come late as they fan out for home. This controlled pace scenario strongly favours hold-up horses and prominent runners who can quicken, while the lone leader Parish Express faces a wall of closers in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Parish Express sets a moderate gallop and the field bunches turning for home
scenarios.body: The controlled pace allows patient riders to time their challenges perfectly, with stamina-laden closers having enough left to reel in the leaders. Hold-up specialists get the ideal setup to unleash late kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady but prominent runners position perfectly to pounce
scenarios.body: Well-positioned horses like Ballyadam and Tassarolo can use their tactical speed to strike before the hold-up brigade gets organized. Their stamina proves decisive when the closers' challenges come too late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Parish Express Survives
scenarios.trigger: If no serious challenges materialize until too late in the straight
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows Parish Express to dictate throughout and maintain enough for the finish when the field finally mobilizes. Her controlled fractions prove the key to staying power.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Parish Express goes too slowly and creates a cavalry charge finish
scenarios.body: The crawling pace turns this into a pure sprint finish where class and tactical speed matter most. The best horses on ratings can overcome poor positioning through sheer ability.

watchPoints.text: Parish Express could get an uncontested lead if no other pace angles emerge, making her very dangerous despite poor recent form
Desert Friend's 10-year-old legs may not handle the sustained finish if the pace becomes truly-run despite his recent Sligo success
All In Peder returns after 382 days off which is a massive concern even though he won this race previously
Eben Zaabeel tries tongue tie for the first time which could unlock improvement if it helps his breathing
Watch for Sonic Invader to be held up longer than usual given his proven stamina pattern over middle distances

races.paceDynamic: Quinta Do Lago is the confirmed front runner and will dictate proceedings from the outset, with The Mediator and Ndaawi likely tracking in prominent positions early. With only one genuine pace-setter in a small field, this sets up for a sustainable tempo that won't overly stress the leaders through the middle stages. The modest pace will allow hold-up horses like Sky Captain, Act Of God, Chain Of Destiny and Talking Tough to stay in touch before the final climb. This race shape clearly favours front-running and prominent racers who can control their own destiny rather than relying on others to collapse.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Quinta Do Lago Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Quinta Do Lago gets an uncontested lead and maintains rhythm
scenarios.body: The 4yo dictates comfortable fractions and has first run on rivals turning for home, with class telling in the finish. Ndaawi and The Mediator benefit from tracking the winner but lack the pace to reel him in.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Ndaawi Class Tells
scenarios.trigger: If Ndaawi's superior ability overcomes tactical disadvantage
scenarios.body: The dual-purpose star uses his Galway Hurdle class to grind down Quinta Do Lago in the final furlong despite giving the leader first run. His OR 90 rating proves decisive against this moderate opposition.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sky Captain Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong and leaders tire
scenarios.body: The lightly-raced 5yo benefits from recent Killarney disappointment being forgiven and sweeps up weary front-runners with his hold-up style. The visor helps him find extra gear when produced with his challenge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Mediator Veteran Guile
scenarios.trigger: If The Mediator finds his autumn dual-purpose form
scenarios.body: Elliott's 9yo uses his recent amateur contest wins to time his challenge perfectly between horses, catching both leaders and closers napping. His proven stamina at this trip gives him the edge in a grinding finish.

watchPoints.text: Quinta Do Lago getting soft lead - if uncontested early he becomes very hard to peg back with his natural pace advantage
Ndaawi's fitness after 100-day break - any signs of rustiness early could compromise his superior class advantage
Sky Captain's visor debut - new headgear suggests connections expect sharper performance than disappointing Killarney effort
Early pace development - if genuinely strong it transforms race dynamics and brings hold-up horses into play
The Mediator's jumping - any mistakes will kill momentum for prominent runner returning after long layoff
